verdict.rationale: Dagster's docs show schedules that run jobs at intervals from hourly, daily or weekly up to arbitrary cron expressions, plus AutomationCondition.on_cron, sensors for event-driven runs, and UI/API-triggered runs, including triggering Airbyte syncs. Together these give per-pipeline control over run frequency. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sub-hour intervals (only implied by cron support), dedicated manual-trigger docs beyond the dbt/Airbyte integration mentions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
